Completion evidence (all 5 ACs met):

- Landed: Gerrit change 1322, merged commit de0deb0c89 (server-side rebase of 9030648cec; original chain commit 70370adf6f repaired via rebase to carry its own heldout test updates — CI tests each patchset tree as-pushed).
- All three auto-bug filers audited against docs/bug-creation-contract.md; site x element table in the commit message. Heartbeat canary: NEW 2-consecutive-red threshold via gh-api run history (query failure fails toward NOT filing), <=1 marker/24h accumulation, abort-if-empty exit 1, detected_by=heartbeat-canary. Binding-drift canary: accumulation + abort-if-empty + detected_by (no threshold — drift is persistent state, documented). Conflict filer: NEW per-pair sha1 dedup tag, accumulation, abort-if-empty, detected_by=reconciler-conflict, no auto-close (needs adjudication, documented).
- Conflict filer extracted from applier.py (at 800 cap) into rebar_reconciler/conflict_bug_filing.py; monkeypatch seam applier._file_conflict_bug_ticket preserved, signature widened to (cli_path, pending).
- Heldout canary suite: 28/28 pass on the change's own tree (verified pre-push after the rebase repair).
- Full unit run green in CI (Verified+1 on patchset 2, run 30863153417 lineage; merged).
